name: Ilthalaine
summary: In Shadowglen, Ilthalaine keeps watch over the sacred glade and guides young night elves as they begin their lives in Teldrassil. He teaches them to defend their home and tend its balance.

sections.title: Guardian of the Glen
sections.body: Ilthalaine watches the woodland paths just outside Shadowglen's heart. He sees changes in the forest that ordinary eyes miss. When young night elves awaken to their duties, he welcomes them and grounds them in Kaldorei traditions. His guidance prepares them to care for Teldrassil and shoulder the responsibilities of its defenders.

sections.title: The Balance of Nature
sections.body: Heavy spring rains have brought more nightsabers and thistle boars to Shadowglen than the glade can feed. Ilthalaine asks young defenders to thin their numbers, leaving room for the woodland's other creatures to flourish and restoring nature's balance.

sections.title: A Guide to Discipline
sections.body: Ilthalaine tests young elves against local wildlife and points them toward their chosen callings. He gives each traveler a class sigil and directs them to their mentors in the Aldrassil sanctuary. Warriors, druids, rogues, priests, and hunters all find where their service to the Kaldorei begins.

faq.answer: Ilthalaine watches over Shadowglen, the sheltered glade in Teldrassil. He introduces newly arrived night elves to their duties and the state of the forest.

faq.q: What is Ilthalaine's role in Shadowglen?
faq.answer: Ilthalaine watches Shadowglen's wildlife and teaches young night elves to preserve nature's balance. He sends them to hunt and points them to their class mentors inside Aldrassil.

faq.q: Why does Ilthalaine want the young nightsabers and boars culled?
faq.answer: Heavy spring rains have increased the nightsaber and thistle boar populations beyond what Shadowglen can support. Ilthalaine asks for their numbers to be thinned so nature's balance can be preserved.

faq.q: What are the sigils he gives out?
faq.answer: Ilthalaine gives novices class sigils and directs them to their mentors within Aldrassil, including priestesses, druids, warriors, and rogues.
Ilthalaine stands on Shadowglen's central path, just south of Aldrassil's great hollow bough in Teldrassil.

faq.q: Is Ilthalaine affiliated with the druids or the sentinels?
faq.answer: Ilthalaine guides novices of every discipline in Shadowglen. He is attuned to nature's harmony and represents the Kaldorei there.

angles.text: As a young night elf, you meet Ilthalaine first. He teaches you to care for your home on Teldrassil and preserve its sacred balance.
As a budding druid, you find your first practical lessons in Cenarion principles in Ilthalaine's teachings on culling and nature's balance.
As an Alliance champion, you meet Ilthalaine's calm Kaldorei vigilance as he welcomes new champions into the service of Darnassus and the Alliance.
